title: Stasis & Spells Shop
description: A rustic wooden storefront at dusk displays a large weathered hanging sign for 'Stasis & Spells Est. 1337' featuring a glowing blue clock with a butterfly in the center and the text 'No Haggling with the Unseen.' The blue wooden building has a lit doorway, shelves of potions and candles visible inside, and a smaller sign reading 'Gallery of Locked Moments.'
prompt: A moody twilight scene of an old blue wooden magic shop on a cobblestone street. A large, tattered hanging wooden sign reads 'Stasis & Spells Est. 1337' with a glowing blue clock face containing a blue and white butterfly at its center and the text 'No Haggling with the Unseen.' Beside the open shop door are glowing candles, potion bottles on shelves, and a smaller sign that says 'Gallery of Locked Moments.' Atmospheric fantasy illustration.
